title: incorrect behavior of DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available
body:
### Tested versions

Godot: 4.5-stable

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot 4.5-stable - Vulkan (forward+) - RTX 3070 TI

### Issue description

The incorrect behavior of DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available() method always returns true on android, even if there is no touchscreen (for example, if android is running on a laptop or PC without a touchscreen)
at the same time DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available() returns false on my touchscreen laptop and tablet, both of which run on windows. While you can still play on a laptop using hardware input methods, games on a tablet always run without an on-screen GUI, which makes them completely unplayable.
You should also be aware that you can install Windows 11 on modern smartphones and run x64 applications from a PC.

### Steps to reproduce

build a project that displays the status of DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available() and export it for android and windows. then run it on an android device without a touchscreen, you will still see the value true.
then run windows release on any windows device with a touchscreen, and you will see the value false.
you can also try to build a linux release and run it on a pine phone, and you will probably see the value false.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jDZqU4NvgcCCU72wXdhMAAPG33FNrFNd/view?usp=sharing
